description:
"The only way to break the curse might be for the two of us to... do that."

Ashton, her childhood friend and arch-nemesis, has been struck by the curse of an ancient relic.

"So this state of arousal caused by the spell can't be relieved on your own—you unconditionally need someone else's help."

And the only person who can help him with this is Roseanna.
No matter how annoying he is, she only meant to help him out for old times' sake...

His face flushed with arousal, his voice desperately calling her name, and his eyes burning with longing for her—everything about him began to invade Roseanna's daily life.
